summary: Five churches (Blessed Sacrament, St. John the Baptist, St. Paul, St. Stephen, St. Timothy). The schedule and Adoration and Confession listings on p2 are identical in all five bulletins read, so all weekly slots are settled. Dated: Triduum for Life Masses at the St. John Neumann Shrine chapel (Oct 26-28), the Nov 2 Mass of Remembrance, the Nov 14 Mass for the Loss of a Child and the Nov 29 Memorial and Healing Mass. No open questions.
